name: arrowhead-oracle
description: Dumps the oracle's own getArrowheadPoints/getArrowheadSize/getArrowheadAngle (packages/element/src/bounds.ts) as fixtures the Rust arrowhead geometry is diffed against. Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace, like rough-oracle: it pins roughjs to the exact version Excalidraw uses, which is the whole point, and must not inherit the workspace's minimumReleaseAge hold.
